description:
Rhat

🎩 When stealing becomes an art... thanks to a magical hat!

In Rhat, step into the shoes of a cunning thief armed with nothing but your magical hat. Use your hat to steal treasures, sneak through traps, and escape without a trace.

Welcome to Rhat!

In this creative and quirky game, you play as a clever thief who uses their magical hat to outsmart traps and collect precious loot. Navigate through challenge-filled rooms and prove that your hat is your ultimate ally!

The Concept

  • A multifunctional hat: Throw your hat to activate mechanisms, retrieve loot, and bypass tricky obstacles.
  • Clever puzzles: Explore levels designed to test your problem-solving skills.
  • Smooth and strategic gameplay: Rhat offers a puzzle-packed experience focused on creativity and thoughtful solutions.

About Us

We’re a team of two passionate creators: 👾 A developer/level designer and 🎮 a game designer/ sound designer. This project was born from Mini Jam #38, inspired by the themes theft and hat.

Download the Game

Ready to dive into this bold adventure? Download Rhat now! We’d love to hear your feedback—don’t hesitate to share your thoughts in the comments. 🎉
